title: Wiping Out the Assassin Dynasties
summary: An envoy of an ancient king clan claims a hundred thousand li around its sleeping grounds until Sheng Huangzi reveals himself as the Holy Prince of the Holy Monkey line and sends him off, warned to 'beware those behind you'. Ye Fan thanks the Peacock King, the Red Dragon Daoist and the Crow Daoist and learns that Yaochi quietly summoned them, since it can't take sides openly; the Great Bandits pledge help through Li Heishui. A Qishi Academy elder recruits Ye Fan on the Queen Mother's recommendation and mentions an ancient trial road beyond this domain, open only to the top three of a generation. Seeing a road home to Earth, Ye Fan promises to come once he can make the top three, and tells Liu Yiyi he'll go to the Central States to reach Immortal Platform. He parts from Ji Ziyue as 'a very, very important friend', holding back his feelings because he'll one day leave this world. Before leaving, he destroys a Hell dynasty stronghold with the Heavenly Court's techniques, then sets out for the Central States keeping a low profile, though Hei Huang says he used the formation wrong and it points toward the Western Desert.
